description: This file contains unit tests for WebLink functionality, including WebServer and WebClient classes, using Google Test framework. It tests WebSocket communication over TCP/IP within the Thunder project, focusing on request/response handling and connection management.

classes.name: WebServer
classes.description: A test WebServer class derived from WebLinkType, handling incoming Web requests and sending responses within the test environment.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A test WebClient class derived from WebLinkType, simulating a client that sends requests and processes responses in the test environment.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to the request or response.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming requests or responses, performs assertions on their contents.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the connection (empty in this test).

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves received data from the WebClient.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for data to be available.
